The best part of this experience was the part I couldn’t film. 🤍 

I had such a beautiful day at Cascada — movement, mineral water, a smoothie, time to read, and actual space to slow down.

But the Sanctuary downstairs was something else.
No phones. Silence encouraged. Mineral water, hot tub, cold plunge, and the salt air lounge that ended up being my favorite part of the entire experience.
And honestly, not being able to capture it made me appreciate it even more.

Sometimes wellness isn’t about doing more. Sometimes it’s giving yourself permission to completely unplug.
Cascada, you were lovely. And Bend… you have something very special coming. ✨  @cascada.bend 

Big gratitude to @cascadapdx @dustisom for this incredible experience.

I am no longer looking forward to the weekend. At least not to do the rest that I know my body needs. I’ve been wanting to book a spa day for months but kept telling myself that I hadn’t done enough to “treat my self” to it but after a Monday that left me feeling like I’d lived a thousand lives in one day, I decided enough was enough listening to my bodies needs isn’t “treating myself,” it’s a necessity.  

2 hours at CASCADA PDX Thermal Springs + Hotel made me feel more like myself than I have in months. Stepping into their outdoor Secret Garden was the much-needed break from my work from home life and immediately felt like stepping into a vacation, and that feeling was further enhanced stepping into the warm, tropical environment of the Conservatory. The warm vitality pool felt like the hug my touch deprived self had been needing. 

Relaxation feels so unfamiliar to me that having their hydrothermal circuit available was a great way for me to turn my overthinking brain off and listen to what my body needed. And it turns out that something my body needed was silence. Stepping into the silent underground Sanctuary, I truly felt a weight lift off my chest and I walked out of there feeling like a new person. #nervoussystemreset #selfcare #restoration

Stayed the night @cascadapdx here in NE Portland and I feel like a new person 🤩From the thermal pools, the thoughtfully designed hotel room, such a good reset. Thank you for having us!

We are incredibly honored to share that CASCADA has been named the No. 4 Best Domestic Wellness Retreat in Travel + Leisure’s 2026 World’s Best Awards.

More than 661,000 votes were cast by Travel + Leisure readers around the world, making this recognition especially meaningful.

CASCADA was built around a belief that wellness could be something deeper. That hospitality could reconnect us to ourselves, to one another, and to the natural world. That design, food, art, movement, rest, and ritual could all live together under one roof.

To be recognized among the very best wellness retreats in the country, less than two years into our journey, is difficult to put into words.

To our extraordinary team: this belongs to you. Every thoughtful detail, every warm welcome, every meal, every treatment, every class, every perfectly prepared space, every moment of care. You are the heart of CASCADA.

To our members, guests, neighbors, partners, and the Portland community: thank you for believing in us, supporting us, and making this place what it is.

And to every Travel + Leisure reader who voted for CASCADA: thank you. We are deeply honored.

No. 4 in the country.

Born in Portland.

And we’re only getting started.

Find yourself here. 🌿
